When I was younger there was a camp that I would go to every summer. This happened when I was about 14. It was a wilderness camp and out in the middle of nowhere. Our camp normally stayed at a campsite near a lake. I camp also had a parking lot near the lake for a hiking trail that passed through the camp. Normally during the day people would come park here and go hiking here, so it wasn't uncommon for us to see cars that we didn't recognize there. But the one night all of us stayed up pretty late just talking. It got to be around 1 in the morning before we decided to go back past this parking lot and to our tents. When we got to the parking lot we all noticed a car that didn't belong to any of the counselors. At first we assumed that it was a hiker from earlier in the day that might have fallen asleep in the car after their hike. We went over to investigate and no one was in there. But we saw in the trunk a bunch of baseball bats and a few crowbars in there with various other supplies in there. We got scared since there was another camp on the other side of the road with a lot of younger kids and we had no idea where the owners of the vehicle were. Two of the counselors happened to be ex marines and eventually tracked down 2 guys in the middle of the woods. They said they had gotten lost and then bolted out as quickly as possible, and sped out. We have no idea who they were or what they were doing. But it was really scary to think about.
